mapper.select: SELECT * FROM coupon WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND receive_start_time <= NOW() AND receive_end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM coupon WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon SET remain_count = remain_count - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND remain_count > 0 AND deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT c.id, c.coupon_name, c.type, c.threshold_amount, c.discount_amount, c.total_count, (c.total_count - c.remain_count) AS received_count, IFNULL(u.used_count, 0) AS used_count, c.per_limit, c.receive_start_time, c.receive_end_time, c.valid_days, c.status FROM coupon c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT coupon_id, COUNT(*) AS used_count FROM user_coupon WHERE coupon_status = 1 GROUP BY coupon_id ) u ON u.coupon_id = c.id WHERE c.deleted = 0
AND c.status = #{status}
AND c.coupon_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
